description: Sanitized ASX classification excerpts for deterministic regression evaluation.

fixtures.rationale: Quarter token and explicit trading update identify the main purpose.

fixtures.title: March 2026 Quarterly Activities Report
fixtures.rationale: A quarterly activities report is an operational quarterly update.

fixtures.rationale: The whole-token 2Q marker and sales-period context are quarterly.

fixtures.title: Quarterly Production Report
fixtures.rationale: Quarterly production reporting belongs to the quarterly operational category.

fixtures.title: Fourth Quarter Trading Update
fixtures.rationale: The title states the quarter and trading-update purpose.

fixtures.title: Half Year Results

fixtures.title: Interim Results Announcement

fixtures.title: Half-Year Financial Statements
fixtures.rationale: The punctuation variant half-year is explicitly supported.

fixtures.title: Full Year Results

fixtures.title: Preliminary Final Report

fixtures.rationale: Year-end results are full-year financial results.

fixtures.rationale: Concise annual reports remain part of the annual-report category.

fixtures.title: Annual Report and Accounts
fixtures.rationale: The title and comprehensive annual sections identify the report.

fixtures.title: Integrated Annual Report 2026
fixtures.rationale: An integrated annual report is still primarily an annual report.

fixtures.title: Dividend Distribution

fixtures.title: Notification of Cessation of Securities

fixtures.title: Change in Number of Securities on Issue
fixtures.rationale: The document formally reports securities on issue.

fixtures.title: Equity Raising

fixtures.title: Placement and Entitlement Offer
fixtures.rationale: Placement and entitlement offer are explicit raising forms.

fixtures.title: Board Appointment

fixtures.title: Management Restructure

fixtures.title: Regulatory Investigation
